_note: Key path: relocated_angle_contacts[*].angle -> relocated_angle_contacts[*].body -> relocated_angle_contacts[*].contact_strength. Angles use long canonical names only (Ascendant, Midheaven, Descendant, Imum_Coeli -- Vertex never appears here; formulas/standard/angularity.py's AXIS_ANGLES excludes it from angle-contact detection). Bodies covered explicitly below are the 10 core planets (Sun through Pluto) -- see BODY-level 'fallback' under each angle for North_Node, South_Node, Lilith_BML, and custom asteroids, which are NOT given their own columns so this file stays a bounded grid instead of exploding to 30+ body keys per angle. Strength bands are tight (0.00-2.00 deg), moderate (2.01-5.00 deg), and wide (5.01-8.00 deg) -- these are evaluate_angularity's own computed bands, not editorial invention; see LOCATION_EVIDENCE_RECORD_CONTRACT.md's tolerances table. IMPORTANT: a same-place or otherwise 'quiet' relocation (zero house changes) can still have angle contacts -- relocated_angle_contacts describes the relocated chart's angularity as a standalone fact, not a diff against natal angularity. See LOCATION_EVIDENCE_RECORD_SAMPLES.md Sample B, where 0/14 houses changed but 5 angle contacts were still present. Do not write a leaf that assumes 'quiet' and 'no evidence' are the same thing. Modulation variables NOT built into this key path, to be applied by the selector/content layer at prose-selection time (per PROSE_PURPOSE_REVIEW.md): (1) natal_modifiers[body].condition_classification -- excellent/strong can support smoother, more available language; challenged/severely_challenged should add handling/friction language, not doom language; missing (nodes/Lilith/asteroids have no natal_modifiers entry) means describe the contact without a condition qualifier rather than inventing one. (2) natal_modifiers[body].was_natal_angular -- True means this is repeated emphasis (already a central natal function, now also relocated-angular); False means the place is newly foregrounding a function that was not already structurally central. These should read differently. (3) purpose_lens -- the same Venus/Midheaven contact is useful evidence for 'career' or 'creative_visibility', a mixed signal for 'rest' or 'retreat', and low-signal for an unrelated lens; see PROSE_GUIDE.md's Purpose Lens section and EVIDENCE_TO_MEANING_MATRIX.md's Purpose Lens Modifiers. (4) relationship_to_place -- a short_visit reads this contact as activation/testing; residence/current_home reads it as operating environment; past_home reads it retrospectively; remote_connection reads it symbolically rather than as embodied daily contact. claim_level 'bounded_interpretation' on every leaf below signals: name the mechanism, translate to lived language, state what it does not guarantee -- see PROSE_GUIDE.md's 'Mechanism -> lived expression -> useful participation -> boundary' pattern.

fallback._note: Broad relocated-angle contact leaf for any angle not enumerated below (should not occur -- the engine only ever emits the four AXIS_ANGLES) or any future angle added to the evidence contract. Keep this leaf generic on purpose: it exists as a structural safety net, not a content target.
